lines.zh: 两副骨架走一条路，步子总差半拍。
lines.en: Two skeletons, one road, our steps always half a beat apart.

lines.zh: 我左边迈腿，右边那具才跟上。
lines.en: My left side steps, and only then does the right follow.

lines.zh: 我们共用一副影子，走得歪。
lines.en: We share a single shadow and walk crooked.

lines.zh: 骨节相撞，咔哒咔哒像敲木鱼。
lines.en: Our joints knock together, clacking like a wooden drum.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，另一具总撞门框。
lines.en: I hug the wall; the other half keeps hitting the door frame.

lines.zh: 走过沙地，四行脚印只算一行。
lines.en: Across the sand we leave four prints that count as one.

lines.zh: 我们转身要转两次才转过来。
lines.en: Turning takes us twice as long as it should.

lines.zh: 肋骨碰肋骨，一路响到洞口。
lines.en: Rib against rib, we clatter all the way to the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 谁先迈步，另一个就被拽着走。
lines.en: Whoever steps first drags the other along.

lines.zh: 我们的膝盖在同一个节奏里响。
lines.en: Our knees click in the same rhythm.

lines.zh: 夜里走，两具骨架的声音像一队。
lines.en: Walking at night, our bones sound like a whole patrol.

lines.zh: 我朝亮处走，另一具往暗处偏。
lines.en: I head for the light; the other half leans into the dark.

lines.zh: 我们站着，两副下颌一起空咬。
lines.en: We stand still and both jaws chew at nothing.

lines.zh: 风穿过四排肋骨，声音不一样。
lines.en: Wind passes through four rows of ribs, each with its own note.

lines.zh: 我数自己的骨头，另一具也在数。
lines.en: I count my bones, and the other half counts too.

lines.zh: 谁的指节动了一下，另一个跟着动。
lines.en: One knuckle shifts, and the other side shifts with it.

lines.zh: 我们背靠背站着，其实长在一起。
lines.en: We stand back to back, though we grew joined.

lines.zh: 骨头里没有血，可我们还是冷。
lines.en: No blood in our bones, yet we are still cold.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有弓弦响，不是我们的。
lines.en: I hear a bowstring far off, and it is not ours.

lines.zh: 两副骨架同时歪头，看同一只蝙蝠。
lines.en: Both skulls tilt to watch the same bat.

lines.zh: 我们安静的时候，骨缝还在响。
lines.en: Even at rest, our bone seams keep creaking.

lines.zh: 站久了，连接处的骨头发涩。
lines.en: Standing long, the joint where we meet grows stiff.

lines.zh: 两个头一起看你，你却只看见一个。
lines.en: Two skulls look at you, and you see only one.

lines.zh: 我左边的眼窝看你，右边也看你。
lines.en: My left eye socket watches you, and so does the right.

lines.zh: 你数我们有几只手，数了两遍。
lines.en: You count our hands, then count them again.

lines.zh: 我们盯着你的护甲，算该从哪咬。
lines.en: We stare at your armour and plan where to bite.

lines.zh: 你把盾举起来，我们两个都退了半步。
lines.en: You raise your shield, and both of us step back.

lines.zh: 我们的下颌同时响，像在商量。
lines.en: Our jaws click together as if conferring.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，骨头记得这个味。
lines.en: You smell of iron, and our bones remember that smell.

lines.zh: 我歪头，另一具的头歪向另一边。
lines.en: I tilt my skull; the other tilts the opposite way.

lines.zh: 你看我们的接缝，我们就知道你想砍那。
lines.en: You look at our seam, so we know where you will strike.

lines.zh: 两个视线落在你身上，只有一个想法。
lines.en: Two gazes rest on you with a single thought behind them.

lines.zh: 骨头断了，我们还能站着。
lines.en: A bone breaks and we can still stand.

lines.zh: 疼的是连接处，不是伤口。
lines.en: The pain is in our seam, not the wound.

lines.zh: 你砍掉我一截手臂，不碍事。
lines.en: You cut off part of my arm; it hardly matters.

lines.zh: 两具身体同时缩了一下。
lines.en: Both bodies flinch at the same time.

lines.zh: 骨屑落在地上，白得像盐。
lines.en: Bone dust falls to the ground, white as salt.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打歪，另一具扶住我。
lines.en: The blow knocks me sideways and the other half steadies me.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨断了两根，反正不用呼吸。
lines.en: Two ribs snap, and we do not breathe anyway.

lines.zh: 痛从接缝传过去，两个都叫不出声。
lines.en: Pain crosses the seam and neither of us can cry out.

lines.zh: 我们退了一步，骨头还在响。
lines.en: We step back and the bones keep rattling.

lines.zh: 再砍几下，我们就该分家了。
lines.en: A few more hits and we will have to part.

lines.zh: 你拿骨头引我们？我们自己就是骨头。
lines.en: Bones to lure us? We are made of bone.

lines.zh: 肉我们不要，牙已经磨平了。
lines.en: We do not want meat; our teeth are worn flat.

lines.zh: 别摇那根骨头，我们不会过去。
lines.en: Stop waving that bone; we will not come.

lines.zh: 食物逗不活死人，我们只认活物。
lines.en: Food cannot rouse the dead; we only want the living.

lines.zh: 你把腐肉丢下，我们连看都不看。
lines.en: You drop rotten flesh and we do not even look.

lines.zh: 我闻到了活人的味道，不是面包。
lines.en: I smell something living, and it is not bread.

lines.zh: 你举起弓，我们更想听弦响。
lines.en: You raise your bow, and we would rather hear the string.

lines.zh: 甜的东西对骨头没用。
lines.en: Sweet things do nothing for bones.

lines.zh: 你把骨头扔远，我们两个都没动。
lines.en: You throw the bone far, and neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 引诱我们先要弄明白我们缺什么。
lines.en: To lure us, first learn what we are missing.

lines.zh: 你撞上接缝，我们差点分成两半。
lines.en: You hit our seam and we nearly come apart.

lines.zh: 骨头顶着骨头，我先退了一步。
lines.en: Bone against bone, and I give way first.

lines.zh: 我们挤过门的时候，总有一个卡住。
lines.en: When we squeeze through a door, one of us always sticks.

lines.zh: 你一推，两副骨架歪向同一边。
lines.en: One push and both skeletons lean the same way.

lines.zh: 肘骨撞在墙上是脆的响声。
lines.en: An elbow hits the wall with a brittle crack.

lines.zh: 我们撞到一起，肋骨互相别住。
lines.en: We crash together and our ribs lock.

lines.zh: 你从我俩中间挤过去，骨头都松了。
lines.en: You squeeze between us and our bones loosen.

lines.zh: 碰一下，肩胛骨错开半寸又卡回。
lines.en: One bump and a shoulder blade slips, then clicks back.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖撞到你的盾，裂了一道。
lines.en: My knee hits your shield and splits.

lines.zh: 两具身体一起被撞退，像一个人。
lines.en: Both bodies are knocked back as if they were one.

lines.zh: 我们本来就是一对了，不用再找。
lines.en: We are already a pair; there is nothing to seek.

lines.zh: 没有第三具骨架愿意靠近我们。
lines.en: No third skeleton wants to come near us.

lines.zh: 我们连在一起，找伴是多余的事。
lines.en: We are joined, so finding a mate would be pointless.

lines.zh: 别问我们谁娶谁，骨头不分这个。
lines.en: Do not ask who wed whom; bones make no such distinction.

lines.zh: 想过分开，可分开就是死。
lines.en: We have thought of parting, but parting is death.

lines.zh: 两副骨架靠在一起，比什么都安静。
lines.en: Two skeletons leaning together are quieter than anything.

lines.zh: 我们不需要另一个，已经够吵了。
lines.en: We need no third; we are noisy enough.

lines.zh: 春天来了，骨头也不会开花。
lines.en: Spring comes, and bones still do not bloom.

lines.zh: 我们并排躺着，谁也没先散。
lines.en: We lie side by side, and neither comes apart first.

lines.zh: 要找伴，得先找到能一起长骨的人。
lines.en: To find a mate, find someone whose bones could grow with ours.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根断骨，试着接在肩上。
lines.en: I pick up a broken bone and try it on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 另一具也伸手，抢同一根骨头。
lines.en: The other half reaches for the same bone.

lines.zh: 地上有块骨片，我们各拿一半。
lines.en: A bone shard lies there; we each take half.

lines.zh: 我抓起弓，另一具按住我的手。
lines.en: I grab a bow and the other half pins my hand.

lines.zh: 箭我们捡了，弓却拉不开。
lines.en: We pick up arrows but cannot draw the bow.

lines.zh: 我把头骨抱起来，仔细看了看牙。
lines.en: I lift a skull and study its teeth.

lines.zh: 东西掉在脚边，两双手同时伸出去。
lines.en: Something falls at our feet and both sets of hands reach.

lines.zh: 我们捡起一把土，又让它漏掉。
lines.en: We scoop up soil and let it drain through our fingers.

lines.zh: 谁捡到归谁，这是我们唯一的规矩。
lines.en: Finder keeps it; that is our only rule.

lines.zh: 我抱着一堆骨头，像抱着自己。
lines.en: I hold an armful of bones as if holding myself.

lines.zh: 你一开口，四只眼窝同时转向你。
lines.en: You speak, and four eye sockets turn at once.

lines.zh: 我们听见你的心跳，两副骨架都静了。
lines.en: We hear your heartbeat and both skeletons go still.

lines.zh: 你踩断树枝，我们就知道方向。
lines.en: You snap a twig and we know the direction.

lines.zh: 活人的热气在夜里很清楚。
lines.en: The warmth of a living body is clear at night.

lines.zh: 我们挑中你了，两个人一起挑的。
lines.en: We chose you, and both of us chose.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，那正是我们要的。
lines.en: You back against the wall, which is what we wanted.

lines.zh: 我抬头，另一具也抬头，目标是你。
lines.en: I look up, the other looks up, and the target is you.

lines.zh: 骨头里的旧记忆说：追会跑的那个。
lines.en: Old memory in the bone says: chase the one that runs.

lines.zh: 你在洞口站住，我们开始挪步。
lines.en: You pause at the cave mouth and we start moving.

lines.zh: 我们合计好了，先咬你的腿。
lines.en: We have agreed: your legs first.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁甲反光，正好指路。
lines.en: Your iron armour glints and points the way.

lines.zh: 两副骨架同时绷紧，连接处发响。
lines.en: Both bodies tense and the joint between us creaks.

lines.zh: 别动，你一动我们就追得更快。
lines.en: Do not move; the more you move, the faster we chase.

lines.zh: 我们的猎物总在夜里最明显。
lines.en: Our prey always stands out most at night.

lines.zh: 你咳嗽了一声，我们两具都转了头。
lines.en: You cough once and both of our heads turn.

lines.zh: 我们追你，四只脚踩出一个节拍。
lines.en: We chase you and four feet beat one rhythm.

lines.zh: 你左转，两副骨架一起歪过去。
lines.en: You turn left and both skeletons lean after you.

lines.zh: 连接处拉扯着疼，我们没减速。
lines.en: The seam pulls painfully, and we do not slow.

lines.zh: 骨头撞石头，声音一路跟着你。
lines.en: Bone knocks stone and the sound follows you.

lines.zh: 你跑上坡，我们的膝盖响得更急。
lines.en: You run uphill and our knees click faster.

lines.zh: 我们分不清是谁在追，反正都在追。
lines.en: We cannot tell which of us chases; both do.

lines.zh: 你在前面喘，我们在后面空咬。
lines.en: You pant ahead of us; we bite at nothing behind you.

lines.zh: 你扔下东西想引开我们，没用。
lines.en: You drop things to distract us, and it fails.

lines.zh: 我们绕着树追，接缝差点挂住。
lines.en: We chase around a tree and our seam nearly snags.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我的手就能碰到你。
lines.en: A little closer and my hand will reach you.

lines.zh: 谁先够到你，另一个会不高兴。
lines.en: Whichever of us reaches you first, the other will sulk.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在墙上跑成一个怪物。
lines.en: Our shadow runs along the wall as one monster.

lines.zh: 你停下，我们也停下，只停半步。
lines.en: You stop; we stop too, but only for half a step.

lines.zh: 别指望甩掉两副一起跑的骨架。
lines.en: Do not expect to lose two skeletons running as one.

lines.zh: 我们一步步逼近，骨节响成一串。
lines.en: We close in step by step, joints clicking in a chain.

lines.zh: 你退向门口，我们先堵那边。
lines.en: You retreat to the door; we block it first.

lines.zh: 两副身体一起伏低，接缝发响。
lines.en: Both bodies stoop together and the seam creaks.

lines.zh: 你数我们几个，我只数了一次。
lines.en: You count how many we are; I counted once.

lines.zh: 两把刀同时落下来，你只挡得住一把。
lines.en: Two blades fall at once and you can block only one.

lines.zh: 我的指骨掐进你的手臂。
lines.en: My finger bones dig into your arm.

lines.zh: 另一具从侧面撞你，骨头硌人。
lines.en: The other half rams your side, all sharp bone.

lines.zh: 我们咬下去，牙齿在你甲上打滑。
lines.en: We bite down and our teeth slide off your armour.

lines.zh: 这一击之后，我们的肩骨脱了位。
lines.en: After that swing our shoulder bone pops out.

lines.zh: 你砍断我一根肋骨，另一具照样扑。
lines.en: You cut one of my ribs and the other half still lunges.

lines.zh: 我们两个一起挥，节奏是乱的。
lines.en: We swing together, and the rhythm is chaos.

lines.zh: 骨头顶在你胸口，像一根冷硬的棍。
lines.en: Bone presses your chest like a cold hard rod.

lines.zh: 你后退，我们两副骨架一起前压。
lines.en: You retreat and both skeletons press forward.

lines.zh: 打击落下时，连接处绷得发白。
lines.en: When the blow lands, our seam stretches pale.

lines.zh: 我们撞开你的盾，指节掉了两枚。
lines.en: We knock your shield aside and lose two knuckles.

lines.zh: 你打中一边，另一边立刻还手。
lines.en: You hit one side and the other strikes back at once.

lines.zh: 我们的攻击没有力气，只有硬度。
lines.en: Our blows have no strength, only hardness.

lines.zh: 你听见骨裂声，分不清是谁的。
lines.en: You hear bone crack and cannot tell whose.

lines.zh: 我们一左一右同时抬手。
lines.en: We both raise an arm, left and right.

lines.zh: 指骨刮过你的喉咙，很轻。
lines.en: Finger bones graze your throat, lightly.

lines.zh: 沙土里先伸出两只手，然后才是我们。
lines.en: Two hands push out of the sand first, then the rest of us.

lines.zh: 墓穴的砖缝里，两副骨架一起长成。
lines.en: In a tomb's brick seams, two skeletons grow as one.

lines.zh: 夜里刷怪蛋落地，我们并着站起来。
lines.en: A spawn egg lands at night and we rise together.

lines.zh: 连接处在黑暗里先连上，再长出骨头。
lines.en: In the dark the seam joins first, then the bones grow.

lines.zh: 我们从同一堆白骨里爬出，没分开。
lines.en: We crawl from the same heap of white bone, unseparated.

lines.zh: 月光照下来，四个眼窝同时发亮。
lines.en: Moonlight falls and four eye sockets gleam at once.

lines.zh: 我们睁眼时，先听见彼此的骨响。
lines.en: When we wake, the first sound is each other's bones.

lines.zh: 地底的潮气把我们粘成了一体。
lines.en: The damp underground stuck us into one body.

lines.zh: 从沙里站起来，肩胛骨卡在一起。
lines.en: Rising from the sand, our shoulder blades catch together.

lines.zh: 我们试着分开走，第一步就摔倒。
lines.en: We try walking apart and fall on the first step.

lines.zh: 这一夜给了我们两副身体一条命。
lines.en: This night gave us two bodies and one life.

lines.zh: 刷怪笼响了一声，我们就出生了。
lines.en: The spawner clicks once and we are born.

lines.zh: 我们从一具尸体里长出两副骨架。
lines.en: Two skeletons grew out of a single corpse.

lines.zh: 第一次迈步，我们就学会了一起走。
lines.en: On our first step we learned to walk as one.

lines.zh: 火舔着骨头，油一样地响。
lines.en: Fire licks our bones with a sound like frying oil.

lines.zh: 摔下去，我们散了一地又拼回。
lines.en: We fall, scatter across the ground, and piece back together.

lines.zh: 水进不了肺，可我们还是往下沉。
lines.en: Water cannot fill our lungs, yet we still sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我们炸开，一半飞了很远。
lines.en: The blast tears us apart and half flies far away.

lines.zh: 箭穿过肋骨，卡在中间出不来。
lines.en: An arrow passes between ribs and lodges there.

lines.zh: 魔法打在接缝上，两个头都在抖。
lines.en: Magic hits our seam and both skulls shake.

lines.zh: 我们不吃，可身体还是在空耗。
lines.en: We do not eat, yet our bodies still wear away.

lines.zh: 雷落在骨头上，白得刺眼。
lines.en: Lightning strikes bone and the white is blinding.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，两副骨架终于分开。
lines.en: Falling into the void, the two skeletons finally part.
